crossRefs.note: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather…
“Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house…
His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

translations.web: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.
translations.bsb: “Let it be as you say,” she replied, and she sent them away. And when they had gone, she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
translations.kjv: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
translations.asv: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
